name: Duelist
description: Precise and reactive. Turns the enemy's attacks against them.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: Blocks the next hit within {duration}s and reflects {reflect*100}% of it back

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.description: Instantly makes an extra weapon attack

abilities.name: Feint
abilities.description: The enemy's next weapon attack misses

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: Makes {hits} extra weapon attacks over {duration}s

name: Berserker
description: All in on damage. Hits hard, heals by hitting, ignores stuns when raging.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.description: Deal {(mult-1)*100}% more damage for {duration}s, but take {(taken-1)*100}% more

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Heal {fraction*100}% of the damage you deal for {duration}s

abilities.name: Shout
abilities.description: Stuns the enemy for {duration}s

abilities.name: Rampage
abilities.description: Weapon cooldown x{mult} and immune to stuns for {duration}s. Breaks current stuns

name: Guardian
description: Hard to kill. Absorbs, braces and outlasts.

abilities.name: Shield
abilities.description: Gain a shield absorbing {fraction*100}% of your max HP for {duration}s

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.description: +{add*100}% damage reduction for {duration}s, ignoring the cap

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.description: Removes stuns and enemy debuffs. Usable while stunned

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.description: Invulnerable for {duration}s, reflecting {reflect*100}% of blocked damage

name: Trickster
description: Slippery and annoying. Slows the enemy down and steals their power.

abilities.name: Smoke
abilities.description: +{add*100}% dodge chance for {duration}s

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.description: Enemy weapon cooldown x{mult} for {duration}s

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Your next weapon attack is a guaranteed crit

abilities.name: Mirror
abilities.description: Copies all of the enemy's active buffs for {duration}s

name: Gambler
description: Everything is a coin flip. Big swings, big stories.

abilities.name: Coin Flip
abilities.description: Your next hit deals x{win_mult} or x{lose_mult} damage

abilities.name: Double Down
abilities.description: +{add*100}% crit chance for {duration}s

abilities.name: Jackpot
abilities.description: {chance*100}% chance to stun the enemy for {duration}s, otherwise earn {money}$

abilities.name: All In
abilities.description: Your next {hits} hits each deal x{mult} damage or miss ({chance*100}% each)

name: Sniper
description: Patient and deadly. Sets up one huge shot.

abilities.name: Aim
abilities.description: Your next hit deals +{(mult-1)*100}% damage

abilities.name: Mark
abilities.description: The enemy takes {(mult-1)*100}% more damage for {duration}s

abilities.name: Retreat
abilities.description: +{add*100}% dodge chance for {duration}s

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.description: After a {windup}s wind-up, hits for {fraction*100}% of the enemy's current HP
